utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Sure — I can help with the carpool. What do you need me to do?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Thanks, Mara — if you could take the Thursday pickup this week, that’d be a huge help. I can cover next time.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Absolutely — I’ve got the Thursday pickup this week. Thanks, and I’ll take you up on that next time.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sounds good—what time should I be there for carpool?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Could you be here by 7:30? That gives us a little buffer before we head out.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Yep, 7:30 works for me. I’ll be there on time.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I can keep track of the carpool supplies—just tell me who’s riding and what time we’re leaving.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Thanks, Cleo — I think it’s Sam, Priya, and me, and we were leaving around 7:30. I might be forgetting someone, though.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Got it — I’ll put down Sam, Priya, and you for 7:30, and we can add anyone else if they come up.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I’m happy to help with the carpool—what time were you thinking?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Rey — I’m just trying to line up the timing. If you’re okay with it, maybe around 7:30 would be safest?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: 7:30 works for me.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Hi Nell, are we still on for the carpool today?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I think so, but I’m waiting on a second-hand update—can you text me the time again?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Sure — I’ll text you the time again now. Just let me know if anything changes.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, I heard the carpool’s still on for tomorrow—same pickup spot, just a little earlier than usual.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Yep, that works for me—I’ll be there a bit earlier too.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Perfect, thanks Gus—I'll let everyone else know so nobody's late.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hey Opal — I’m putting together the carpool and thought of you first. Want me to save you a spot?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Yes please — save me a spot. Just let me know the pickup time and where you’re meeting.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’ll save you a spot. I’m still locking in the final pickup time, but I’ll text you as soon as it’s set and where we’re meeting.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure thing — I can help with the carpool. What time do you need me?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Can you confirm what time you’re thinking?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I’m thinking around 7:30 AM — does that work for you?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Bo — I’m Rosa. Want to sort out the carpool schedule together?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sure — happy to. What days and times are you thinking?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Great — I’m thinking weekdays for school drop-off and pickup, around 7:30 AM and 3:30 PM. Does that fit your schedule?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Sounds good — I’ll repeat the carpool plan to everyone and make sure the details are clear.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thanks, Vik. That works for me—just let me know if anything changes.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Will do — I’ll pass it along and keep you posted if anything changes.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right — the carpool. I’m a bit foggy, but I’m happy to help figure it out if you tell me the plan.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Oren. I’m still sorting it out, but I’ll tell you the plan as soon as I have it.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: No worries, Uli — just let me know when you’ve got it, and I’ll be there.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I can help coordinate the carpool—who needs a ride, and what time are we aiming for?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Thanks, Jules — I think it’s Mia, Ben, and me, and we should aim for about 7:30.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Perfect — I’ll line up Mia, Ben, and you for 7:30. I’ll check who can drive and make sure everyone’s in the loop.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: I’m happy to help spread the word about the carpool—want me to invite a few neighbors?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Yeah, that’d be great—please invite a few neighbors. I may show up a little late, but I’d love to be included.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely—I’ll let a few neighbors know, and I’ll tell them you may be a little late but still want in.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I’m happy to help with the carpool—what time were you thinking?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thanks, Rey—let’s keep it simple and do 7:30 in the morning. If that works for you, I’ll have everything ready.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: 7:30 works for me. I’ll be there on time.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Morning, Mara — are we still set for the school carpool today?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Morning, Faye — yes, we’re still set for the school carpool today. I’ll be ready at the usual time.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Perfect, thanks — I’ll swing by at the usual time.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Hey Vik — I can help line up the carpool if you want. Just tell me who’s riding and what time works best.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: That’d be great, Jules. I’m thinking of Maya and Sam, and around 8:15 works best for us.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Perfect — I’ll set it up for Maya and Sam at 8:15. If anything changes, just text me and I’ll adjust it.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing — I can lend a hand with the carpool if you need me to.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Gus — that helps. I just want to make sure the pickup times and routes are sorted so nobody gets left waiting.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Absolutely — I can help map out the pickup times and a simple route so it’s clear for everyone. Just send me the addresses and I’ll sort it out.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I’m ready to keep track of the carpool details—what time and pickup spot should I note?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Opal—please note 8:15 AM at the community center entrance.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Got it — 8:15 AM at the community center entrance. I’ll note that for the carpool.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Hi Hana, are we still good for the carpool this morning?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Hi Mina — yes, I think so, but let me double-check the time and pickup spot before I confirm.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Sure — what time and pickup spot should I plan for?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure thing — what do you need to figure out for the carpool?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I just need to check who’s riding with whom and whether we’ve got enough seats.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I can help map that out — tell me how many riders we have and how many seats are in each car.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, I’m still catching up—has the carpool time changed, or are we keeping the same schedule?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: I think it’s still the same schedule, but I might’ve missed an update—let me check and get back to you.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, I’d appreciate that — I’m still a bit out of the loop.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: So, we’re still on for the carpool, right?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Yep, still on — I’ll be ready when you are.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Great — just confirming, same pickup spot and time as usual?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Hey Uli, any updates on the carpool? I’m headed out for errands and wanted to see if we’re all set.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Hi Ira — I’m still not quite set, but I’m working on it. I’ll let you know as soon as I can.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Thanks, Uli — just ping me when you know, and I’ll plan my errands around it.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh right, the carpool — I’m pretty sure I can help, but I may need the time and pickup spot again.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sure — it’s at 7:15 by the front gate. Thanks, Oren.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Yep, got it — 7:15 by the front gate. I’ll be there and keep an eye out.
